coordinate_system: Source xyz; floor-indexed bins; no browser transform or spawn validation
probability_claim: Unique sampled-round support for qualifying holds; regional unions divided by matching side/phase sampled rounds are descriptive sample frequencies, not opponent-presence or population probabilities

source.author: Julien Blanchon
source.title: OpenCS2 Dataset
source.license_caveat: Author declares renders/metadata CC-BY-4.0; HLTV demo source subject to original tournament terms; independent rights clearance not established

method.selection: SHA-256 ranked complete matches, then ranked rounds; all ten POVs
method.dwell_allocation: Left endpoint of adjacent eligible intervals; no terminal extrapolation
method.episode_anchor: Greatest-dwell bin; lexicographic tie-break; visits may span bins
method.round_support: Unique match_id/round keys; union cells before counting regional support
method.primary_signal: Union nearby same-side/phase cell roundKeys, intersect layer roundKeys; episodes, anchors and dwell are diagnostic, not the regional support numerator
method.training_weight_interpretation: Parent normalizes 1 + unique nearby supported rounds within each validated course; unknowns retain exploration weight; bots/run is a separate training setting
method.layer_round_denominator: roundKeys: sampled phase-potential rounds; observedRoundKeys: rounds with adjacent alive intervals
method.weapon_column: input_weapon; input_weapon_id retained for measured name/ID audit; no separate equipped-weapon column in sidecars
